text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A birthday present! I was just wanting 
some golf wear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wonderful. You mentioned you've been 
working hard lately, so I chose some 
activewear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I was super hyped! I saw a pro wearing it 
in a magazine the other day and was 
thinking how cool it looked!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Seeing it in person makes it even more 
impactful and cool... Man, I wonder if I 
can really pull this off?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The clothes will wear you instead at this 
rate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She'll be fine, it's Palmer after all. 
Besides... Sister is the one who chose 
this design.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She said eye-catching colors and patterns 
like this suit Palmer much better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Go on and add some color to it, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. Yes. Thank you very much, both 
of you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I won't let this outfit outshine me— I'll 
show everyone what I'm made of!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes, I'll be waiting for good 
news.
